saw_lines: Weekly grocery buyers repeat the same basket, so they judge a store by freshness, price and delivery.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line of the ad, before the shopper ever reaches the cart.
5 of your 9 fixed copy ads share one text, so repeat viewers see the same pitch. Rewrite the opening line and swap the creative, leading with a weekly staples list.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 24 Nov 2026
points: 5 of your 9 fixed copy ads use the same text, so repeat viewers see the same pitch. Keep the copy, rewrite the opening line and swap the creative. Lead with a weekly staples list and a fresh produce shot.

0 of your 9 fixed copy ads carry a proof number, so a new shopper has no reason to believe the promise before clicking. Collect a count, such as orders delivered in Täby, and open the next batch with it.
0 of 9 ads mention an offer or discount, so a new buyer sees no reason to act today. Give them one reason to buy now, a first order offer or a weekly staples bundle, and lead new ads with it.

5 ads have run 60+ days, but none of your 6 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line. Build the next batch as variations of the oldest winner and keep its first line, so the new ads start from proven ground.
